title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: The team agreed to test AppLovin with MAIA's best Meta videos cut under 60 seconds with animated offer end cards, starting with 20 to 30 videos. Production shifts toward cholesterol, brain, neuropathy and prostate because the main campaign already has about 90 videos. Scaling happens near 0.8 ROAS only where there are enough videos to support it.
points: AppLovin: repurpose Meta winners, test single-video against multi-asset creative sets, possible $700 to $1,000 a day later
Neuropathy and prostate budgets cut to about $1,500 to $2,500 because new video volume was low
Cholesterol fell the most and needs two to three new videos a day; only about four are in the pipeline
Brain holds at about $5,000 a day and cannot scale without more videos
Blood Sugar launched at $1,000 a day with one video (rejected) and six statics
AVIA near target at about $5,000 a day; November budget about $300,000 to $320,000, expected revenue about $250,000
AVIA videos sent to the PDP converted (about $350 spend, around 1.0 ROAS)
Black Friday: buy two products and get three gifts, aimed at site visitors who did not buy
decisions: Pause new blood pressure, plaque and blood-flow submissions for about five days and redirect production to under-covered angles
Scale around 0.8 ROAS only where creative supply supports it; main campaign stays unscaled while below 0.8
Send 100% of MAIA video traffic to the PDP; new static ads use a new pre-sales link for comparison
Keep Blood Sugar at the test budget through the weekend and pause it Sunday or Monday if it does not develop
No AVIA scaling until creative supply improves
